(च न, SV.) and not, also not, even not, not even (this particle is placed after the word to which it gives force; a preceding verb is accentuated [Pāṇ. viii, 1, 57]; in Vedic language it is generally, but not always, found without any other neg. particle, whereas in the later language another neg. is usually added, e.g. आपश् चनप्र मिनन्ति व्रतं वां, ‘not even the waters violate your ordinance’, RV. ii, 24, 12; नाह विव्याच पृथिवी चनैनं, ‘the earth even does not contain him’, iii, 36, 4; in class. Sanskṛt it is only used after the interrogatives क, कतर, कतम, कथम्, कद्, कदा, किम्, कुतस्, क्व, making them indefinite), RV.; AV. &c. also, RV. i, 139, 2; vi, 26, 7; viii, 78, 10.
a: चन — ind. Not, not also, even not (not used by itself, but found used in combination with the pronoun किम् or its derivatives, such as कद्, कथं, क्व, कदा, कुतः to which it imparts an indefinite sense; see under किम्). Note. Some regard चन to be not a separate word, but a combination of च and न.

AkASe candrasya prakASaH । sa ca yaddine sArdDapraharadvayavyApinI yA tiTistattiTyanusAreRa Bavati । tasya pramARaM yaTA, purARasamuccaye । “gavAM krIqAdine yatra rAtrO dfSyeta candramAH । somo rAjA paSUn hanti suraBIpUjakAMstaTA ॥ tadudayasamBAvanaYca nirRayAmfte nirRItam । pratipadyAparAhRikatrimuhUrttavyApinyAM dbitIyAyAM candradarSanaM samBAvyate । taduktamagnyAGAnavizaye vfdDaSAtAtapena । dvitIyA trimuhUrttA cet pratipadyAparAhRikI । agnyADAnaM caturddaSyAM parataH somadarSanAditi ॥ aparAhRaSca paYcaDAviBaktasyAhnaScaturTo BAgaH । tataSca yatra pratipadi zaRmuhUrttavyApinI dbitIyA tatra candradarSanasamBAvanamiti .” iti SrIhariBaktivilAse 16 vilAsaH ॥ (candrasya vastraKaRqAdiracitacandrAkfterAtapo yatra .) candrAtapaH । OzaDaviSezaH । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 345 ॥ sa tu makaraDvajAKyarasasindUram । yaTA, -- “palaM mfdu svarRadalaM rasendraM palAzwakaM zoqaSa ganDakasya । SoREH sukArpAsaBavEH prasUnEH sarvvaM vimarddyATa kumArikAdBiH ॥ tatkAcakumBe nihitaM sugAQe mftkarpawEstaddivasatrayaYca । pacet kramAgnO sitakAKyayantre tato rajaH pallavarAgaramyam ॥ nigfhya cEtasya palaM palAni catvAri karpUrarajastaTEva । jAtIPalaM sozaRamindrapuzpaM kastUrikAyA iha SARa ekaH ॥ * ॥ candrodayo'yaM kaTitastu mAzo Bukto'hivallIdalamaDyavarttI । madonmadAnAM pramadASatAnAM garvvADikatvaM SlaTayatyakARqe ॥ GftaM GanIBUtamatIva dugDaM mfdUni mAMsAni samastakAni । mAzAnnapizwAni Bavanti paTyAnyAnandadAyInyaparARi cAtra ॥ * ॥ valIpalitanASanastanuBftAM vayaHstamBanaH samastagadaKaRqanaH pracurarogapaYcAnanaH । gfhezu rasarAqayaM Bavati yasya candrodayaH sa paYcaSaradarpito mfgadfSAM BaveddurllaBaH ॥” iti sArakOmudI suKaboDaSca ॥
